Package dev.px.core.account

Class Account

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.account.Account
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named
public final class Account extends Object implements Named
A saved account entry in the alt manager.

No credentials are stored. Microsoft accounts authenticate through the platform's device-code flow at login time, so there is nothing worth writing to disk and nothing to leak if a config is shared.

invalid @link 
#getMetadata()
is a free-form string map for whatever a particular client tracks per account — a ban expiry, a rank, a note. Keeping it open means Core does not need to know about any one server's concepts to store them.
